name: Cá Mập Ma Dạ Quang
description: Thân hình bán trong suốt phát ra ánh sáng huỳnh quang mờ ảo trong những đêm sương mù giăng kín.
subject: Pale icy-blue ghostlike shark, softly translucent skin, visible fin structure and restrained spectral glow; complete shark silhouette.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual game collectible bitmap, used unchanged in admin, inventory and held-fish previews.
Primary request: Create one new species at the same finished rendered quality as the three supplied reference fish.
Input images: Image 1 swordfish, Image 2 rainbow guppy, Image 3 golden dragon fish. All three are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Do not copy their anatomy or regenerate these references.
Style/medium: Polished dimensional game render with sculpted volume, realistic small surface details, glossy eyes, finely resolved scales or appropriate skin, delicate fin rays and rich material shading. Match the references' level of finish.
Composition/framing: One isolated complete subject, mainly side profile with subtle three-quarter volume. Face left for the game's holding layout; upright species remain naturally upright. Center the entire silhouette with at least 8 percent clear space around every appendage.
Lighting: Soft studio key light from above, controlled highlights and subtle cool rim light; highlights follow real body curvature.
Backdrop: Completely flat uniform pure green #00FF00, used only for removal after generation; no green cast on the subject, no contact shadow.
Constraints: Preserve the species anatomy and the existing game's identifying details. No pixel art, flat vector shapes, thick outlines, brush strokes, watercolor, crude gradients, toy-plastic fish, collage, multiple specimens, environmental scene, typography or watermark.
Subject: Pale icy-blue ghostlike shark, softly translucent skin, visible fin structure and restrained spectral glow; complete shark silhouette.
Existing game identity (preserve relevant visual details): Thân hình bán trong suốt phát ra ánh sáng huỳnh quang mờ ảo trong những đêm sương mù giăng kín.
